name: saas-custom-domains
description: Add custom domains with automatic SSL to your SaaS app, and manage your customers' domains, DNS and traffic, with the SaaS Custom Domains skill and MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Let your SaaS customers use their own domains. The skill teaches the agent the SaaS Custom Domains API, DNS records, webhooks and how to verify forwarded requests. The MCP server lets it add domains, look up the DNS records your customers need, check why a domain isn't live and read traffic.
defaultPrompt: Add custom domains to this app with SaaS Custom Domains
Add app.acme.com and tell me which DNS records Acme needs
Which of our customers still haven't set up their DNS?
